# Heritage Hotels of India

> > Comprehensive directory of 390+ heritage hotels, royal palaces, and historic properties across India with online booking and curated tour packages.

Heritage Hotels of India specializes in luxury accommodation in converted palaces, havelis, and colonial estates across Rajasthan, Kerala, Uttarakhand, and other Indian states. The platform features detailed listings of heritage properties, the popular Golden Triangle tour, and authentic cultural experiences in historic royal residences.
